shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 2 on the number line on the left with the mark at (1,−4) on the right. Where two raised traces are shown, consider values satisfying both constraints.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The filled dot admits 2 for its own bound, but the other constraint rejects that value. Right image: The point belongs to the plotted graph and gives f(1)=−4.
Rationales: On the left, although the selected dot is filled, the other marked ray does not reach 2. The value is outside the intersection. On the right, the filled marker adds that coordinate pair to the graph and supplies the value at its horizontal coordinate.
